notes: Golden set for Phase 8 triage (docs/ASSISTANT_PHASE8_PLAN.md 16.4). Each case is one fact pack item (facts only, plan 5.3) with the expected decision. expected.decisions, reasons, actions and severities are allowed sets; an empty list means any valid value. Tags: covered_negative (any escalation fails the case), not_urgent (an urgent severity fails the case), time_of_day (weekday night, weekend, holiday, quiet hours), urgent_ok (urgent is a legitimate answer). Calendar fields are derived from `now` (America/Los_Angeles) and pinned by a test. Project numbers are fake (26.11.9xxx). These gates measure the model before release; they are not runtime checks (owner question 6 (c)). Offline `--check` validates structure; the live run (run_triage_evals.py --live) refuses without ASSISTANT_TRIAGE_TEST_SPEND_CAP_USD.
